page.title: Terms & Conditions
page.heading: Please read these terms carefully
page.intro: These Terms & Conditions explain the rules for using the Divaine Tech website and working with our team. They are written to be clear and fair for everyone.

A deposit may be required before work starts; milestone and final payments are due as shown on each invoice.
